description: This file defines application configuration handling for the Career Platform Backend API. It manages environment variables related to JWT security, token expiration, JSON data seeding, and ingestion directory path, encapsulating the settings within a dataclass for use throughout the application.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass that holds core configuration settings loaded from environment variables. Provides a method to compute token expiration as a timedelta.

methods.name: timedelta access_token_expires(self)
methods.description: Calculates the token expiration duration as a timedelta object based on the configured expiry minutes.

methods.name: bool str_to_bool(value: str | None)
methods.description: Converts a string environment variable to a boolean value, interpreting '1', 'true', 'yes', 'y' as True.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads configuration settings from environment variables and returns a Settings object.
